title: Gherkin: standup close-out section + empty Yesterday
description:
## Intent
As a WIP controller, I want a close-out section and explicit empty Yesterday, so standup drives kanban hygiene instead of vague Likely questions.

## Behavior
- Close-out: ready-to-close / merged-but-still-in_progress / blocked-only-on-external-wait
- Replace or demote useless “Why is X still in progress?” Likely questions
- Empty Yesterday: explicit “no completions” (never blank)

## DoD
Gherkin dual-runtime scenarios.
right_now_summary: The team is defining close-out prompts and a clear “no completions” message for empty Yesterday updates.
